title: It is very easy to remove the canister
text:
It is very easy to remove the canister. Reduced to 3 stars and the reason: This vacuum is extremely loud. I didn't realize how loud it was the first time because there was so much noise around me in the house. Now that there are just average sounds in the house, this thing is way too loud. The handheld accessory with the brush in it doesn't work very well. It has great suction, but the moment you put it on something like a mattress to vacuum, the brush stops spinning. I see no use in having a brush on it, if it's not strong enough to keep rotating while vacuuming with the accessory. It's a great concept, but a useless feature.

This vacuum has strong suction. It is very easy to remove the canister to empty it. Bagless is a wonderful invention. I just shove the canister into my garbage can and then press the button. The button placement would be better on top of the canister, but it's not difficult to use in the location it is in. I just feel like my hands are too close to the dust and hair when emptying it. My Dyson's clip is on the top.

description: Hoover PowerDrivePet Upright Vacuum UH74210M is perfect for homes with pets. It combines the power and suction you trust to deliver a deeper clean. Its swivel steering design effortlessly maneuvers around furniture and into tight spaces with ease, while the new Advanced Action Brush Roll is engineered to tackle deep-down embedded dirt and reduce hair wrap. The ON/OFF brush roll feature allows you to transition from carpet to hard floor with the touch of a button to optimize pet hair removal on all floor types. Turn the brush roll ON for deep cleaning on carpets and OFF to prevent scatter of debris on hard floors. With 13 ft. of cleaning reach, multipurpose pet tools, and an extra-large capacity dirt cup, you’ll be able to achieve a whole home clean so you can love your pets, not the hair they leave behind. For over 100 years, Hoover has reimagined the way we clean, delivering a complete collection of trusted, innovative and effective solutions designed to make cleaning easier for active families so they can get back to what matters most.
